_comment: Design tokens for Blessed Botanicals, shaped to match the Klaviyo
create_dnd_email_template `definition.styles` array so they can be injected
in the Rebranding folder of the client Drive. Palette p16, typography
STATUS: target_state. NONE of this is live in Klaviyo today — all six
templates run unmodified Klaviyo stock styling. See design-system.md.
`derived: true` marks a value proposed for email, not lifted from the brand
book. The book specifies families and weights, not an email type scale.
`null` means NOT YET CAPTURED, never 'no constraint'.
source: Drive: Blessed Botanicals/Blessed Botanicals Rebranding/Blessed Botanicals.pdf
blocking_question: Is this rebrand approved and live, or pending client sign-off? Determines whether these are the tokens or a proposal.

forest.observed_usage: footer background, announcement bar, secondary button fill, heading text on light grounds
forest.note: Already in use as the footer section content_color in Klaviyo — the single brand value that made it into the account.

sage.observed_usage: section background blocks, often with botanical line-art

cream.note: Klaviyo currently uses #FFFFFF content on #f5f5f7 canvas. Both are stock defaults and both are wrong: cool grey where the brand is warm cream.

amber.observed_usage: primary button fill with white text; full-bleed hero background band

display.email_risk: Alga is not a Google Font. It will not render in Gmail or Outlook. Given ~90% mobile traffic (mostly iOS Mail, which does support webfonts) the fallback still applies to a meaningful share — the serif fallback must be chosen deliberately, not left to chance.

body.email_risk: Poppins is a Google Font and is the safer of the two, but still falls back in Outlook.

typography._current_state: Templates use Arial/Helvetica in the token layer and 'Assistant' inline in the footer. Assistant appears nowhere in the brand guidelines.

klaviyo_definition_styles._comment: Ready to inject as definition.styles. derived:true values are proposals.

button._source: Read from the email mockups on brand guidelines p26-27; no numeric button spec is given in the book.

primary.text_transform_note: Rendered uppercase in the mockups; set the label in caps since DnD has no transform property.

secondary._note: Used where amber would clash with an amber or photographic ground.

layout._traffic_note: ~90% mobile per the NTK. Design mobile-first, no exceptions.

components._comment: Observed in the brand book's own email mockups (p26-27). Build each as Klaviyo Universal Content so it is edited once and inherited everywhere. Only the footer exists today.

announcement_bar.spec: Full-width forest #1f4d3a band, white Poppins caps, small. e.g. 'FREE SHIPPING ON ORDERS'

header.spec: Centred logo on cream or amber ground; separate mobile/desktop widths via show_on, as the existing footer already does.

hero.spec: Either a photographic image block with the headline as a live text block beneath, or a flat amber band with live Alga headline. Never a headline baked into the image.

feature_badges.spec: 2x2 grid of icon + short label pills on cream. Use split or multi-column rows, not a flattened image.

product_grid.spec: 'Best Sellers' — Alga heading with rule, then product blocks: image, name, SHOP NOW link. Use the native `product` block so the catalog feeds it.

support_block.spec: Sage #a8bfa3 ground with botanical line-art, 'Need Help?' heading, secondary button.

footer.spec: Forest #1f4d3a ground, centred logo, white social icons, 10px white unsubscribe + org address.
footer._note: The only Universal Content in the account. Its font is currently 'Assistant' — update to the Poppins stack.

drive_sources._note: Assets stay in Drive. Pull by ID and push to Klaviyo with upload_image_from_url. Never commit binaries here.

klaviyo_dnd_block_vocabulary._note: The closed set create_dnd_email_template accepts. The design system can only be expressed in these.
